 Coram : Advait M. Sethna, J.
 Date : 7 August 2025
P. C.:
1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The matter is listed for the first time today.
3. Issue notice to the Respondent.
Mr. Goyanka, learned APP waives service for the State.
4. With the assistance of learned counsel for the parties, I have perused the FIR and the record available with the Court.

From a bare perusal of the FIR, it appears that the informant is the father of one Saylee,
who is divorcee having son aged 5 years.
On 17 July 2023 at about 3:56 p.m., the informant received a message on WhatsAPP on his cellphone.
The number from which the message was received was shown of Jivan Jodi.
He received message from the same profile that "Hello I am Riya".
Thereafter, at about 4:01 p.m., he received Bio-data of unknown person named Somesh Shubham Page 1 of 5  925-ABA-1391-2025.doc

sentences.text: 1 Prakash Sahane, age 27 years, resident of Nashik and serving as Assistant Manager, BOI.

As the informant and his wife found the proposal suitable for their daughter, informant replied to the above message at about 9:05 p.m.
and showed interest in the said proposal.
Thereafter, on 20 July 2023 he called on the said cellphone and asked about further information of the proposed groom.

Then, the person who was answering the call told him to deposit Rs.3500/- as registration fees of their institute and assured that thereafter, they will send the contact number and address of the concerned person.
Accordingly, informant paid the amount through BHIM application.
Again, after 20 minutes, he received call from Jivan Jodi institute asking him to deposit Rs.1500/-.

Accordingly, the informant transferred Rs.1500/-
through Paytm and asked to send receipt and mobile number and address of the proposed groom.

Though it was assured that information will be sent by 12:00 noon on the next day, the informant did not receive any information and when he started calling on the said numbers of Jivan Jodi institute,
nobody answered the calls.
In these circumstances, the informant lodged the report and the FIR was accordingly registered.
5. In these proceedings, it is undisputed that pursuant to the filing of the FIR, there is a charge-sheet which is filed on 1 February 2024.
The Applicants who are the accused persons before the Court are not named in the FIR.
The said Jivan Jodi institute which appears to be in the nature of marriage bureau is run by one Sheetal Sunil Gajghate.
She seems to be the Shubham Page 2 of 5  925-ABA-1391-2025.doc proprietor/owner of the said institute.

The said institute is registered having a duly registered certificate, which appears to be issued by Ministry of Shubham Vijaysingh Rajput And Another vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172096783/
2 Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India, which is at page 18 of the Application.

sentences.text: The said Sheetal is shown to be the owner which can be seen from a document annexed at page 81, issued by the said Ministry.
It appears that the said persons may be working at the said Jivan Jodi institute and/or hired by the said Sheetal.
It appears that the said Sheetal has been arrested.
Mr. Goyanka would take instructions in this regard as this facet is not clear at this juncture.

It also appears that the said Applicants after allegedly taken the monies, have returned the same to the informant which is evident from a document annexed at page 83 of the Application, which is a NEFT transaction of 23 September 2023 by which the informant seems to have received an amount of Rs.5,000/-.
6.
The FIR does not refer to any specific role and/or attribute the alleged offences against the present Applicants.
The charge-sheet is also filed which would indicate culmination of the investigation.

From one of the statements recorded during the investigation dated 16 August 2023, which is a part of the charge-sheet, it would refer to the said Sheetal, the manager of the Jivan Jodi, whose numbers etc. have been referred to.
It appears that the prosecution has not issued any notice under Section 41A, of Cr.P.C./Section 35 of the BNSS to these Applicants.
The Applicants have no criminal antecedents.
They undertake to co-operate with the investigation.

In such view of the matter, prima facie, the Applicants deserve to be protected at this stage of the proceedings by passing the following order:-
 ORDER (i) Until the adjourned date of hearing, in the event of arrest of the Applicants in connection with CR No.45 of 2023 registered with Cyber Police Station, Beed for the offences punishable under Sections Shubham Vijaysingh Rajput And Another vs The State Of Maharashtra on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172096783/
3 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 66 and 66D of the Information Technology Act,
2000, the Applicants are directed to be released on bail on their furnishing PR bond in the sum of Rs.20,000 (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) each with one or more sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The Applicants shall cooperate with the investigation and shall attend the concerned police station on every Monday at 11:30 a.m., until further orders.

If there is any change in the contact details, the same shall be immediately intimated to the concerned police station.
(iv) The Applicants shall not leave the jurisdiction of the Court without prior permission/order of the Court, until further 925-ABA-1391-2025.doc orders.

(v) The Applicants shall not influence the witness/es and/or tamper evidence in any manner whatsoever.
7. List the proceedings for further consideration on 29 August 2025.
8.
The protection granted to the Applicant shall continue until the adjourned date of hearing.
